mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accident_point WHERE id = #{value}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trail_segment WHERE id = #{value}

SELECT ts.id AS segmentId, t.id AS trailId, t.source_course_name AS sourceCourseName, ts.source_trail_feature_id AS sourceTrailFeatureId, ST_Distance(a.geom::geography, ts.geom::geography) AS distanceMeters FROM accident_point a JOIN trail_segment ts ON ST_DWithin(a.geom::geography, ts.geom::geography, #{distanceMeters}) JOIN trail_feature tf ON tf.id = ts.source_trail_feature_id JOIN trail t ON t.id = tf.trail_id WHERE a.id = #{accidentId} ORDER BY ST_Distance(a.geom::geography, ts.geom::geography) ASC

SELECT a.id AS accidentId, a.report_no AS reportNo, a.dispatch_date AS dispatchDate, a.accident_type AS accidentType, a.location_name AS locationName, ST_Distance(a.geom::geography, ts.geom::geography) AS distanceMeters FROM trail_segment ts JOIN accident_point a ON ST_DWithin(a.geom::geography, ts.geom::geography, #{distanceMeters}) WHERE ts.id = #{segmentId} ORDER BY ST_Distance(a.geom::geography, ts.geom::geography) ASC
